data.completion_memo: Implemented full one-way Markdown projection from consistent canonical snapshots: opt-in per-project docs/adashi default/configurable directory, identity-hashed filenames, generated MCP authoring notice/content fingerprint, full exact bodies, root index and bounded relative links beside bound code. Added atomic write-if-changed, local ownership manifest/lock, drift detection/repair, owned cleanup on delete/relocation/disable, case/path/symlink/junction validation and separate postcommit MCP projection status. Desktop settings expose directory/status/regeneration. 17 projection/settings tests pass (1 existing manual test ignored), including long Unicode bodies, stable mtimes, rename, relocation, unowned collisions, interrupted output and Windows permission/junction checks. Real MCP SQLite/text tests prove publication failure retains committed content. Native WebView2 settings, MCP-triggered refresh, drift retry and opt-out passed; evidence target/native-storage/90b06759-261b-4d6b-8882-925a60ce57c4. TypeScript and frontend/native builds pass.

lines:
Execution order: Markdown step 7 of 12. Depends on Adashi task ID 30 (Markdown 06/12 — Extend MCP design APIs, schemas and operation help). Complete and verify that prerequisite before starting; all earlier Markdown steps are transitively required.

Extend src-tauri/src/projection.rs and normal project settings to expose canonical Markdown documents naturally in the checkout.
Scope:
- Retain the existing per-project opt-in projection behavior. Default full-document output to docs/adashi, with a configurable project-relative directory; do not assume control of other docs.
- Generate complete bodies into deterministic, collision-safe identity-derived filenames. Title changes keep references stable. Include a root discovery index and bounded links in existing root/folder architecture shorts according to associations and direct code bindings; do not inline full bodies into instruction files.
- Prefix every generated document with the agreed notice: Generated from Adashi; do not edit directly; project and Design ID; agents retrieve current canonical content/readToken and save through the Adashi MCP API; direct file edits will be overwritten on regeneration. Include source fingerprint/revision metadata without unrelated edit churn. The notice is generated, never part of the canonical body.
- Use one consistent snapshot, atomic write-if-changed, local ownership/freshness tracking and owned-only cleanup. Validate paths, case collisions and symlink/junction escapes; never overwrite unowned files or delete unrelated docs on relocation/disable/removal.
- Refresh after observed committed MCP/desktop changes, open/settings changes and explicit regeneration. Detect externally edited generated content as drift; never import it.
- Keep current/stale/missing/drifted/error visible with retry. Saved canonical content remains saved if filesystem publication fails; unchanged regeneration preserves bytes and mtimes.
Acceptance:
- Verify root and nested relative links, project-level discovery, complete long bodies, rename/delete/relocation, opt-out, unowned collision, drift repair, interrupted output and permission failures.
- Validate full output and nearby shorts refer to the same stored document/version and retain existing managed-block user text.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications and linked diagram(s). The Markdown extension saved on 2026-09-25 is approved design; implementation remains pending until this task is verified.
